agents.desc: Solves one full-horizon linear program with the realized demand known in advance. A perfect-information upper bound, not a deployable policy.
Rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program. Samples demand scenarios (SAA) with non-anticipativity constraints and re-solves every period. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Rolling-horizon multi-stage stochastic program. Samples demand scenarios (SAA) with non-anticipativity constraints and re-solves every period. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Rolling-horizon deterministic linear program over a 10-period window, using point demand forecasts and re-solved every period. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Rolling-horizon deterministic linear program over a 10-period window, using point demand forecasts and re-solved every period. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Base-stock target per node from the newsvendor critical ratio b / (b + h) over lead-time demand, with a normal approximation. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Reorder point s = lead-time demand plus safety stock; when inventory falls below s, order up to S = s + EOQ. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Holt double exponential smoothing (level and trend) forecast, with safety stock from the forecast error. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Base-stock target per node from the newsvendor critical ratio b / (b + h) over lead-time demand, with a normal approximation. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Reorder point s = lead-time demand plus safety stock; when inventory falls below s, order up to S = s + EOQ. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Holt double exponential smoothing (level and trend) forecast, with safety stock from the forecast error. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Clark-Scarf-inspired echelon base-stock policy: targets from cumulative lead time and a critical ratio. Blind: estimates demand from realized history only.
Clark-Scarf-inspired echelon base-stock policy: targets from cumulative lead time and a critical ratio. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO with a multilayer-perceptron policy on engineered per-node and global features. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO with a directed, edge-conditioned message-passing graph network over the supply network. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO with a transformer encoder that treats each node as a token. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO with spatio-temporal attention over (node, period) tokens from a 4-period history. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO learns a per-link correction of up to 50% on top of the Newsvendor heuristic's order. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
Soft Actor-Critic with a multilayer-perceptron policy on engineered features. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
PPO with a multilayer-perceptron policy on engineered per-node and global features. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
Behavioral cloning of Oracle decisions into the PPO-GNN architecture, then PPO fine-tuning. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
DAgger imitation of the Oracle (iterative dataset aggregation) with the PPO-GNN architecture. Informed: reads the true mean of the demand process.
DAgger imitation of the Oracle (iterative dataset aggregation) with the PPO-GNN architecture. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
PPO with a directed, edge-conditioned message-passing graph network over the supply network. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
PPO with spatio-temporal attention over (node, period) tokens from a 4-period history. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
PPO learns a per-link correction of up to 50% on top of the Newsvendor heuristic's order. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
Soft Actor-Critic with a multilayer-perceptron policy on engineered features. Blind variant: its features use a moving average of realized demand instead of the true mean.
Observation ablation of PPO-MLP: 3 basic features per node instead of the enhanced set.
Observation ablation of PPO-MLP: the raw 71-dimensional observation with no engineered features. Trained and evaluated on the base network only.
A local LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) is queried once per episode for strategy multipliers that set a bounded base-stock policy.
